attchmntText: Emami Realty Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Rajesh Bansal as Executive Director of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Emami Realty Limited approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter and half-year ended 30th September, 2026. Statutory auditors M/s Agrawal Tondon and Co issued Limited Review Reports with an unmodified opinion. The Board accepted the resignation of Mr. Rajesh Bansal, DIN 00645035, from the office of Whole-time Director, effective 12th November, 2026. His resignation was tendered on 21st September, 2026, due to personal reasons and engagement in other assignments. The Board meeting commenced at 4:30 P.M. and concluded at 5:30 P.M. on 12th November, 2026. Financial results are available on the company website at www.emamirealty.com.

attchmntText: Emami Realty Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Emami Realty Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Emami Realty Limited approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. Statutory Auditors M/s Agrawal Tondon and Co issued Limited Review Reports with an unmodified opinion. The Board accepted the resignation of Mr. Rajesh Bansal, DIN 00645035, from the office of Whole-time Director, effective 12th November 2026. Mr. Bansal resigned due to personal reasons and engagement in other assignments. The resignation was tendered on 21st September 2026 and received by the Company on 9th October 2026. The Board meeting commenced at 4:30 P.M. and concluded at 5:30 P.M. on 12th November 2026. Financial results are available on the Company website at www.emamirealty.com.
